message: Last summer, we had a power outage right in the middle of my favorite show. I was all set to binge-watch, but as the lights flickered out, my phone battery was down to 5%. I scrambled to find a flashlight and ended up charging my phone with a power bank while setting up a cozy little lantern situation. It made me realize how important it is to keep our devices charged and have a backup plan in place. Have you ever found yourself in a tech pickle during an unexpected power outage?
